preheader: OpenAI drops live internet training, Medicare cuts hit millions, and Eka Robotics raises $150M.

lead.headline: OpenAI cuts live web access for AI training over unpredictability risks
lead.body: OpenAI is stepping back from training its frontier models on the live internet, opting instead for cached copies and simulated versions. The lab announced the shift just weeks after an engineer questioned whether the approach would work. At the same time, OpenAI resumed reinforcement learning after beefing up security and patching a data compression flaw in Brotli.
lead.why: As you build your startup knowledge, pay attention to how frontier labs manage operational risk. Infrastructure bottlenecks and security guardrails dictate the speed at which AI companies can scale.

stories.headline: Humana and UnitedHealthcare cancel Medicare Advantage plans for 1 million seniors
stories.body: Two of the largest U.S. health insurers are discontinuing various Medicare Advantage plans starting next year, citing rising health care costs and a spike in patient utilization. The cuts leave millions of seniors scrambling for alternative coverage as broader market pressures mount.
stories.why: Understanding how regulatory shifts and rising costs force massive enterprises to prune business lines is a key analytical skill for corporate strategy and consulting.

stories.headline: Trader Joe's chicken wraps confirmed as source of ongoing E. coli outbreak
stories.body: Federal health authorities and the Department of Agriculture have confirmed that chicken wraps sold at Trader Joe's caused an E. coli outbreak that has sickened at least 50 people. The investigation linked the illness directly to the retailer's pre-packaged food supply.
stories.why: Supply chain failures in food retail highlight why rigorous quality control and risk management are critical when managing operations at scale.

stories.headline: UK government commits $800 million to AI security and defense funding
stories.body: Britain's government has announced roughly $800 million in funding geared primarily toward defending against health and security threats tied to artificial intelligence. The bulk of the capital will target major systemic risks in automated environments.
stories.why: Public sector investments in cybersecurity create massive compliance markets. This is fertile ground for tech consulting firms advising enterprise clients on risk management.

stories.headline: Google Messages rolls out Enhanced Protection mode against spam and scams
stories.body: Google is rolling out an Enhanced Protection mode for Android users of Google Messages to counter sophisticated spam and scams. The feature upgrades the existing standard protection block list to handle modern threats.
stories.why: Consumer software feature rollouts show how platform owners continuously layer security to build consumer trust, which is vital for maintaining app engagement.

stories.headline: McKinsey notes aging private jets could trigger a new business aviation capacity crunch
stories.body: The global business aviation industry faces a looming capacity shortage as older private jets approach major maintenance milestones or retirement. Limited new aircraft production makes it difficult for operators to replace aging fleets.
stories.why: Niche asset shortages create high-margin consulting opportunities in fleet management, logistics, and capital allocation strategy.

stories.headline: Korn Ferry report finds 76% of talent leaders say entry-level jobs are not disappearing due to AI
stories.body: New global research indicates that 81% of employers plan to increase early-career hiring. Talent leaders emphasize that junior roles are shifting toward human judgment, problem-solving, and oversight rather than vanishing entirely.
stories.why: As a first-year business student, this is reassuring data on how corporate recruiting is adapting to AI rather than cutting entry-level pathways.

stories.headline: UC Irvine criminology research prompts OC prosecutors to expunge DNA database profiles
stories.body: The Orange County district attorney's office agreed to remove profiles from its DNA database to settle a constitutional lawsuit. A UC Irvine criminology professor who challenged the program called the move an important step forward.

term.name: Trailing Dividend Yield
term.definition: Trailing dividend yield is a financial metric calculated by dividing the total dividends a company paid over the last 12 months by its current share price. While investors use it to screen for high-income stocks, it can be misleading due to one-time special payouts or unsustainable payout ratios. For instance, Indian stocks currently offering high yields require deeper fundamental analysis rather than just surface-level screening.

serve.headline: Eka Robotics raised $150 million in a Series A round led by Andreessen Horowitz and F-Prime to teach robots to feel.
serve.body: The Cambridge, Massachusetts-based startup builds robots designed to handle objects using touch alongside sight, moving beyond traditional vision-only systems. The capital will fuel its mission to give industrial automation a better sense of physical touch.
